timothy2.3.p1.b1.text: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.

timothy2.3.p1.b2.text: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!

timothy2.3.p2.b1.text: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women …

timothy2.3.p2.b2.text: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth.

timothy2.3.p2.b3.text: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.

timothy2.3.p3.b1.text: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,

timothy2.3.p3.b2.text: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.

timothy2.3.p3.b3.text: What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

timothy2.3.p4.b1.text: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.

timothy2.3.p4.b2.text: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures,

timothy2.3.p4.b3.text: which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

timothy2.3.p5.b1.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,

timothy2.3.p5.b2.text: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
